title: Binary Search Tree Iterator
constraints: At most 10^5 calls to next() and hasNext()
inputFormat: Implement class BSTIterator. Its constructor receives a root node with val, left, and right fields; the runner converts the shown level-order array to that tree. Operations are [method] calls on the same instance.
outputFormat: next() returns the next-smallest number; hasNext() returns a boolean without advancing. Output lists method results in call order. Each test creates a fresh iterator.

visuals.title: Read the tree in ascending order
visuals.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 380 255" role="img" aria-label="BST with root 7, left child 3, and right subtree 15 with children 9 and 20" style="width:100%;height:auto;max-width:380px;color:var(--color-text)"><path d="M190 30L95 105" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><path d="M190 30L285 105" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><path d="M285 105L235 180" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><path d="M285 105L335 180" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><circle cx="190" cy="30" r="21" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="190" y="36" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">7</text><circle cx="95" cy="105" r="21" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="95" y="111" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">3</text><circle cx="285" cy="105" r="21" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="285" y="111" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">15</text><circle cx="235" cy="180" r="21" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="235" y="186" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">9</text><circle cx="335" cy="180" r="21" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="335" y="186" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">20</text><text x="190" y="220" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16">next(): 3 → 7 → 9 → 15 → 20</text></svg>
visuals.caption: Each next() advances one step through this sequence. hasNext() only reports whether another step is available.
